plan.purpose: One fixed research-only linear baseline for apparent adult-male appearance from stored exact FFHQ W; no attractiveness prediction
plan.features: float64 copy of saved w[0,0,:], after asserting all18 W rows are identical; 512 dimensions
plan.preprocessing: Per-feature mean/std learned from b2 training records only; std floor1e-8
plan.model: Linear logistic regression with intercept; mean binary log loss +0.5*lambda*sum(weight^2); intercept unpenalized
plan.optimizer: scipy L-BFGS-B, maxiter300, gtol1e-8, ftol1e-12; deterministic zero weights and training-prior logit intercept
plan.threshold_selection: Both fixed before fitting, report both; do not select a preferred threshold from test results. Scores are not calibrated probabilities.

optimizer.message: CONVERGENCE: RELATIVE REDUCTION OF F <= FACTR*EPSMCH

limitations: Single-reviewer subjective appearance labels; uncertain examples excluded.
Only29 heldout evaluable sources expected; confidence bounds broad.
Combined adult-male target may learn masculine presentation rather than robust adult discrimination.
No heldout masculine-adolescent coverage is established; age-ambiguous sources excluded by design.
512 features greatly exceed training examples; a successful heldout batch remains a tiny pilot.
Source labels may change with synthesis adaptation even if mapping stays frozen.
No hats, collars, facial integrity, attractiveness, or production latency guarantee.
